cases.name: shares
cases.query:
SELECT 地区, AGG(销售额), AGG(所选地区内销售占比), AGG(占全部地区销售额的比例)
FROM MODEL
WHERE dt_month = '2025-02-01' AND 地区 = 'North'
GROUP BY 地区
cases.sql:
-- dialect: mssql

/** DML_CALENDAR { pk(dt_date) } **/
/** TABLE_SALES { pk(id) } **/

/*------------------------------------------------------*/
/**                       measure                      **/
/*------------------------------------------------------*/

/** [#DML_销售明细_BY_地_DM_94BF81B] { pk(地区, dt_month) } **/
if object_id(N'tempdb..[#DML_销售明细_BY_地_DM_94BF81B]', N'U') is not null drop table [#DML_销售明细_BY_地_DM_94BF81B];
select
    region as 地区,
    dt_month,
    SUM(amount) as 销售额,
    SUM(SUM(amount)) over (partition by dt_month) as 销售额_minus_dim_地区,
    (SUM(amount)) / nullif(SUM(SUM(amount)) over (partition by dt_month), 0) as 所选地区内销售占比
into [#DML_销售明细_BY_地_DM_94BF81B]
from TABLE_SALES
where dt_month = '2025-02-01'
    and region = 'North'
group by region, dt_month;

create unique clustered index idx__地_dm
	on [#DML_销售明细_BY_地_DM_94BF81B]
	   (地区, dt_month);

/** DML_销售明细_BY_地_DM_9F9081B { pk(地区, dt_month) } **/
with DML_销售明细_BY_地_DM_9F9081B as (
select
    region as 地区,
    dt_month,
    SUM(amount) as 销售额,
    SUM(SUM(amount)) over (partition by dt_month) as 销售额_minus_dim_地区
from TABLE_SALES
where dt_month = '2025-02-01'
group by region, dt_month
),

/** DML_销售明细_BY_地_DM_F3A581B { pk(地区, dt_month) } **/
DML_销售明细_BY_地_DM_F3A581B as (
select
    t.地区,
    t.dt_month,
    tf8254.销售额 / nullif(t.销售额_minus_dim_地区, 0) as 占全部地区销售额的比例
from DML_销售明细_BY_地_DM_9F9081B t
left join [#DML_销售明细_BY_地_DM_94BF81B] tf8254 
	on (tf8254.地区 = t.地区 or (tf8254.地区 is null and t.地区 is null))
	and (tf8254.dt_month = t.dt_month or (tf8254.dt_month is null and t.dt_month is null))
)


/*-----------------------------------------------------*/
/**                       query                       **/
/*-----------------------------------------------------*/

select
    coalesce(t1.地区, t2.地区) as 地区,
    t1.销售额,
    t1.所选地区内销售占比,
    t2.占全部地区销售额的比例
from [#DML_销售明细_BY_地_DM_94BF81B] t1
full outer join DML_销售明细_BY_地_DM_F3A581B t2
    on (t2.地区 = t1.地区 or (t2.地区 is null and t1.地区 is null))
    and (t2.dt_month = t1.dt_month or (t2.dt_month is null and t1.dt_month is null))
where coalesce(t1.地区, t2.地区) = 'North'
order by 地区;

cases.name: grain_avg
cases.query:
SELECT 地区, AGG(每笔平均销售额), AGG(客户平均销售额)
FROM MODEL
WHERE dt_month = '2025-02-01'
GROUP BY 地区
cases.sql:
-- dialect: mssql


/** TABLE_SALES { pk(id) } **/

/** DML_销售明细_BY_DM_地_9F9081B { pk([地区]) }  **/
with DML_销售明细_BY_DM_地_9F9081B as (
select
	dt_month,
	region as [地区],
	SUM(amount) as [销售额],
	COUNT(1) as [销售笔数],
	(SUM(amount)) / nullif(COUNT(1), 0) as [每笔平均销售额]
from TABLE_SALES
where dt_month = '2025-02-01'
group by dt_month,
	region
),

/** DML_销售明细_BY_DM_地_C_9F902F0 { pk([地区], customer) }  **/
DML_销售明细_BY_DM_地_C_9F902F0 as (
select
	dt_month,
	region as [地区],
	customer,
	SUM(amount) as [销售额]
from TABLE_SALES
where dt_month = '2025-02-01'
group by dt_month,
	region,
	customer
),

/** DML_销售明细_BY_DM_地_9F90307 { pk(dt_month, [地区]) }  **/
DML_销售明细_BY_DM_地_9F90307 as (
select
	dt_month,
	[地区],
	AVG([销售额]) as [客户平均销售额]
from DML_销售明细_BY_DM_地_C_9F902F0
group by dt_month,
	[地区]
)

/** MAIN_QUERY { pk([地区]) } **/
select
	/** auto-generated by datoml: q21ad008295 **/
	t.[地区],
	t.[每笔平均销售额],
	t5ab65.[客户平均销售额]
from DML_销售明细_BY_DM_地_9F9081B t
left join DML_销售明细_BY_DM_地_9F90307 t5ab65 
	on (t5ab65.dt_month = t.dt_month or (t5ab65.dt_month is null and t.dt_month is null))
	and (t5ab65.[地区] = t.[地区] or (t5ab65.[地区] is null and t.[地区] is null))
order by t.[地区] asc;
